edits.original: Operators procured spinning reserve, rather than non-spinning reserve.
edits.replacement: Operators procured spinning reserve. This is standby capacity held on generators that are already running and synchronized to the grid.
edits.reason: Spinning versus non-spinning reserve is a real technical distinction that most readers wouldn't know, so it gets its own sentence saying what spinning reserve is instead of a tacked-on 'rather than' clause.

edits.original: Those upgrades are planned on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those upgrades are planned on purpose.
edits.reason: 'By accident' is the everyday opposite of 'on purpose', so the trailing clause adds nothing and is cut.
